rules.title: Prefer runtime built-ins
rules.text: Prefer the runtime built-in APIs (Bun.file, Deno.readTextFile, fetch) over extra packages.

rules.title: Minimal Deno permissions
rules.text: Run Deno with the narrowest permission flags required.

rules.title: Respect the lockfile
rules.text: Use the runtime native lockfile and do not mix package managers.

rules.title: Built-in test runner
rules.text: Use the built-in test runner unless the project already uses another.
